async def act(page):
    # Click the 'Write' button to activate the comment input
    await page.get_by_role('button', name='Write').click()
    # Wait for the comment box to appear
    await page.wait_for_timeout(1000)  # Short delay to ensure UI updates
    # Locate the comment box and fill it with 'Good idea'
    comment_box = page.get_by_role('textbox', name='Comment')
    await comment_box.fill('Good idea')
    # Locate and click the submit button for the comment, assuming it's named 'Comment'
    submit_button = page.get_by_role('button', name='Comment')
    await submit_button.click()
    await page.wait_for_load_state('networkidle')
